findings.issue: Concurrent prepare and retries after a failed preparation could create another snapshot.
findings.reproduction: Deferred synthetic prepare_recovery received two awaits and both concurrent requests returned success.
findings.coordinator_fix: Reject closed or already-prepared coordinator before idle/router work.
findings.independent_retest: Deferred snapshot retest proved one await and concurrent FREE_AI_DELIVERY_PENDING; durable regression also covers retry after failed preparation.

findings.issue: Pending automatic reconnect was omitted from initial idle checks and actual start_voice admission.
findings.reproduction: Synthetic reconnect task paused for one second; prepare returned success/closed while reconnect remained pending, then _start_voice_attempt was awaited after closure.
findings.coordinator_fix: Initial idle includes unfinished reconnect/provider cleanup; start_voice and each actual attempt enforce admission.
findings.independent_retest: Pending reconnect retest returned initial BUSY without closure/cancellation; closed start_voice never reached mocked attempt. Durable regression also covers provider cleanup/actual attempt.

findings.issue: TaskStore.active filters the newest 10000 rows after LIMIT, hiding an older nonterminal task.
findings.reproduction: Actual temporary SQLite had one queued task plus 10000 newer completed rows; active() returned [], and preparation succeeded/closed.
findings.coordinator_fix: TaskStore.active uses WHERE state NOT IN terminal before loading, with no history LIMIT.
findings.independent_retest: Actual temporary SQLite retained one old queued task behind 10000 newer completed records; active() returned it and preparation returned initial BUSY/no snapshot.

findings.issue: Background external agent launch can outlive conversation and register a working job after preparation.
findings.reproduction: Deferred synthetic desktop.tell in background agent_action: preparation succeeded with no registered job; resolving tell then registered one working job and its watcher after closure.
findings.coordinator_fix: External action decorator, action_work reservations and action-lock busy check cover agent/note/resume/submit-intent and deferred answer_quickly work.
findings.independent_retest: Deferred background agent launch returned initial BUSY without closure/cancellation; direct new launch rejected after closure. Durable regression and 48 owning MVP tests pass.

additional_source_observations: Initial inherited-client/router-owner/tmux BUSY checks precede lazy router construction; an actual synthetic RouterRuntime constructor probe with inherited client returned BUSY/closed=false without creating state/recovery directories.

Passwd-derived home and /run/user/UID guard environment, Voice paths/symlink ancestors and router.state.directory. Custom environment is rejected before lazy state creation; durable custom state/router regression passes.
Startup ticket barrier runs before VoiceService constructor state creation and again at run; independent actual temporary ticket-presence test proved requested state/runtime paths stayed absent.

Fixed private tmux metadata check runs synchronously with two-second timeout before closure; synthetic exact no-server adapter passes while an existing session or unknown error returns BUSY. No actual host tmux query was performed.
Ticket UID must be non-root current UID, expiry is at most 900 seconds and previousArtifacts requires maslow-voice, aligned with fixed Hub helper. Strict field/identity/expiry/package tests pass.
